home.none: No sessions yet. Press Talk and say hello.
talk.title: Talk
talk.mode.daily.sub: Small talk with a West Coast colleague
talk.mode.mywork.sub: Your real project, as a scenario
talk.mywork.label: Describe your project (1–3 lines, English or Japanese)
talk.mywork.placeholder: e.g. Conveyor line for an Ohio plant. 2 PLCs, 6 VFDs, HMI. Customer wants FAT next month but the drives are late.
talk.mic.denied: Microphone access was denied. Allow it in the address bar and reload.
talk.unsupported: Speech recognition isn't available in this browser. Use Chrome or Edge on PC.
talk.noToken: Set the app token in Settings first.
talk.hint.stuck: Keep going — you can say it simply.
summary.title: Session complete
summary.queued: Saved locally — will sync when online
progress.title: Progress
settings.title: Settings
settings.token.help: Same value as APP_TOKEN on the Worker. Stored only in this browser.
settings.token.noKey: Connected, but ANTHROPIC_API_KEY is missing on the Worker
settings.immersion.high: High — English only, no Japanese anywhere
settings.immersion.medium: Medium — Japanese subtitle hidden; tap 訳 to reveal (counted)
settings.immersion.low: Low — Japanese subtitle always under the AI's lines
settings.wipe.confirm: Delete ALL sessions and stats from the server? This cannot be undone.
settings.token.keyInvalid: Connected, but Anthropic rejected the API key ({hint}). Re-create it at console.anthropic.com → API Keys, paste it into .dev.vars with no quotes or spaces, then restart npm run dev.
settings.token.keyError: Connected, but the Anthropic API returned an error: {msg}
settings.micMode.auto: Auto (always on for PC, tap to talk on iPhone)
settings.sttEngine.browser: Browser (instant text while you speak; weaker with non-native accents)
settings.sttEngine.server: Server — Whisper on Cloudflare (more accurate; text appears after you pause)
settings.sttEngine.help: Server mode records a clip and transcribes it on the Worker. Works on iPhone Chrome. Uses the Workers AI free tier.
settings.sttEngine.missing: The Worker has no speech-to-text yet. Deploy the latest version ([ai] binding) or set STT_API_KEY.
settings.token.keyWorkspace: Connected, but this API key is not tied to a workspace (sk-ant-usr-… keys). Either add ANTHROPIC_WORKSPACE_ID=<workspace id> to .dev.vars (Console → Settings → Workspaces) and restart, or create a key inside a workspace (Console → Workspaces → your workspace → API Keys).
shadow.title: Shadow
shadow.empty: No sentences yet. Add from a conversation, a review, or the phrase bank.
shadow.manual.placeholder: Type an English sentence to practice
shadow.mode.recall.sub: Text hidden. Say it from memory
shadow.fail: Under 70% — this one comes back tomorrow.
review.title: Review
review.empty: No reviews yet. Finish a Talk session and the review appears here.
word.tapHint: Tap a word to look it up
talk.unsupportedServer: This browser can't record audio (MediaRecorder). Use Chrome, Edge or Safari.
talk.engineServer: Recognition: Whisper on the server. Your words appear after you pause (about 1–2 s), not while you speak.
talk.lastClip: Play what the mic heard (last clip sent to the server)
talk.waiting: Listening — recording starts when you speak
settings.debugClips.help: Adds a small player in Talk to hear exactly what was sent for transcription.
summary.missionShort: Mission not counted — say at least 20 words next time.
week.title: This week
week.empty: Nothing yet this week. One session is enough to start.
week.flat: No metric moved more than 5% vs last week yet.
progress.level.B1: Intermediate — can handle everyday work talk
progress.level.B2: Upper intermediate — fluent on technical topics
progress.keepGoing: All criteria met — keep the pace for a few more sessions.
progress.top: Top level reached. Keep it sharp.
progress.year.sub: Speaking minutes per day. Hover a cell.
progress.mastered.empty: Pass a sentence in Recall mode (≥90%) three times in a row and it lands here.
settings.exported: Exported {n} sessions (copy saved to R2 when configured).
settings.saveRecordings.help: Server engine only. Each of your clips is stored in R2 so you can listen back from the Review page.
review.noRecordings: No recordings for this session (enable “Save my recordings” in Settings).
shadow.headphones: Use earphones — the mic must not hear the playback.
shadow.leak: The mic picked up the playback, so this attempt wasn't scored. Use earphones, or practice in Listen → Recall.
settings.ttsEngine.help: Server voices are natural and played by the browser, so echo cancellation can remove them from the mic. Browser voices are the OS's built-in ones.
settings.serverVoice.help: 40 English voices. Try a few with Preview.
home.instant.sub: Japanese cue → say it in seconds
instant.title: Instant composition
instant.intro: See the cue, start speaking within the time limit, then repeat the model answer three times. Pick a level.
instant.level.1.sub: Short everyday sentences from a Japanese cue
instant.level.2.sub: Change one thing: question, negative, tense, modal, passive
instant.level.3.sub: Controls-engineer sentences: vendors, specs, troubleshooting, safety
instant.level.4.sub: No sentence given — say the right thing for the situation
instant.level.5.sub: A point plus a reason or next step, under 3 seconds
instant.generate.help: AI drills are built from your own corrections, your My Work project and this level's pattern. The optional focus narrows the topic.
instant.focus.placeholder: Focus (optional): e.g. vendor calls, past tense, FAT
instant.latency.help: Seconds from cue to your first word
